shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -100 && git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; ls __agent_eval__; rg -n -i -C 4 "toast" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; rg -n -i -C 3 "toast" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button 2>&1 | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Toaster build/esm/components/Toaster/* | head -40; rg -n -i "toast" README.md | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat types.d.ts Toaster.d.ts index.d.ts; ls hooks Provider; cat hooks/useToaster.d.ts

cat constants.d.ts Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; rg -n "autoHiding|DEFAULT" Toast/Toast.js ToastList/*.js constants.js | head -20; sed -n 1,200p /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i "button|view" | head
